title: スプレー式ライン引き台車
description: 駐車区画や園路のライン施工場面向けの小型台車。倒立スプレー缶の外装、開いた保持枠、下向きノズル、幅調整用マスク板、四輪の車台、トリガーと固定ケーブルを造形。缶は無地で、中身・塗膜・噴霧・可動はありません。実際の施工寸法や薬剤使用、安全性能を定める設計ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.476 × 0.964 × 0.868 m、10,976三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A compact trolley for parking-bay and park-path striping scenes, with an inverted unbranded aerosol-can exterior, open holder, downward nozzle, adjustable-mask exteriors, four-wheel frame, trigger and fixed cable. Contents, painted lines, spraying and movement are absent. This is not a design specifying real application dimensions, chemical use or safety performance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.476 × 0.964 × 0.868 m; 10,976 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
